ONLINE INFORMED CONSENT — COMMITTEE DEMONSTRATION ONLY
The proposed study recruits through three brain injury outpatient clinics.
Selected participants receive a welcome package, instructions and a tutorial,
complete a pre-test, take part in their assigned study activities for 30 days,
and complete a post-test. Participation after selection is online.
Research records use participant numbers. The designated administrator can
reveal the identity link through a restricted report; each use is logged.
Participants can email the administrator for technical help or general questions.
Participation is voluntary. You may decline this demonstration without submitting
an application. The final withdrawal procedure and data-retention policy await review.
The committee must supply approved wording covering eligibility, assessments,
risks, benefits, confidentiality, withdrawal, consent capacity/assistance,
compensation if any, and study/independent contact details.
This draft does not enroll anyone in research or claim ethics approval.
Only fictional information may be submitted in this demonstration.
